# Update TMB
```{r}
load("${path_rsrch}/PCAWG/consensus_snv_indel/pcawg_HLAupdateMSS.RData")
number_mutations <- mutCountMatrix(pcawg_MSS, includeSyn = TRUE, countOnly = NULL, removeNonMutated = FALSE)
number_mutations <- as.data.frame(number_mutations)
number_mutations$gene <- rownames(number_mutations)
write.csv(number_mutations, file = "${path_rsrch}/PCAWG/consensus_snv_indel/pcawg_HLAupdateMSS_num_mutations.csv", row.names = F)
```

# Divide TMB by human genome length
```{r}
data <- fread(paste0(path_TMB, "/pcawg_HLAupdateMSS_num_mutations.csv")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-gene) %>% t(.)

result <- data.frame(
  aliquot_id = rownames(data),
  total_mutation = rowSums(data)
) %>% mutate(mutation_perMB = total_mutation/3000)

write.csv(result, file = paste0(path_TMB, "/pcawg_HLAupdateMSS_TMB.csv"), row.names = F)
```
